categories.name: Colors
categories.description: Brand palette (atoms) and derived semantic colours (molecules). Configure the 8 atoms only — molecules self-adapt.

categories.name: Typography
categories.description: Fluid type scale, semantic heading sizes, font families, weights, and line heights.

categories.name: Spacing
categories.description: Fluid space scale for padding, margin, and gap. All values use clamp() — no breakpoints needed.

categories.name: Layout
categories.description: Container widths and viewport reference values. Note: CSS custom properties cannot be used inside @media queries.

categories.name: Effects
categories.description: Border radius (all fluid), shadows (dark-mode adaptive), transitions, z-index layering, and WCAG focus ring.

variables.name: primary
variables.description: Primary brand colour. Replace with your brand OKLCH value. All hover, shadow, and derived tokens auto-adapt.

variables.name: secondary
variables.description: Secondary brand colour.

variables.name: accent
variables.description: Accent / highlight colour. Badges, tags, decorative elements.

variables.name: text-color
variables.description: Body text. WCAG AAA on bg-body in both modes (≥9:1).

variables.name: heading-color
variables.description: Heading text. WCAG AAA on bg-body in both modes (≥15:1). Also seeds --shadow-color in light mode.

variables.name: bg-body
variables.description: Page / body background.

variables.name: bg-surface
variables.description: Card, panel, section surface. Sits one level above bg-body.

variables.name: border-color
variables.description: Default border and divider colour.

variables.name: on-accent
variables.description: Text/icon colour on primary or accent backgrounds. Auto-adapts via bg-body.

variables.name: muted-foreground
variables.description: Dimmed text. Auto-computes from text-color and bg-body. Use for captions, meta, placeholders.

variables.name: surface-muted
variables.description: Muted surface between bg-surface and border-color. Table rows, zebra stripes, subtle dividers.

variables.name: primary-hover
variables.description: Primary shifted 15% darker (light) or lighter (dark) for hover. Fully adapts when primary changes.

variables.name: secondary-hover
variables.description: Secondary shifted 15% for hover. Auto-adapts.

variables.name: accent-hover
variables.description: Accent shifted 15% for hover. Auto-adapts.

variables.name: font-body
variables.description: Font family for body text and UI elements.

variables.name: font-heading
variables.description: Font for headings. Default inherit uses font-body. Set a display font here to differentiate headings.

variables.name: font-mono
variables.description: Monospace font for code blocks and pre tags.

variables.name: text-xs
variables.description: 11→12px fluid. Labels, badges, fine print. Fluid for consistency with all other text tokens.

variables.name: text-s
variables.description: 13→15px fluid. Captions, meta info, secondary copy.

variables.name: text-m
variables.description: 16→18px fluid. Base body text. Scale anchor.

variables.name: text-l
variables.description: 18→24px fluid. Lead paragraphs, intro copy.

variables.name: text-xl
variables.description: 20→32px fluid. Small display text, large UI labels.

variables.name: text-2xl
variables.description: 23→43px fluid. Display headlines, hero copy.

variables.name: text-3xl
variables.description: 26→57px fluid. Large hero headings.

variables.name: text-4xl
variables.description: 29→76px fluid. Statement / display type.

variables.name: h1
variables.description: H1 semantic size. 36→54px fluid. Independent from utility scale.

variables.name: h2
variables.description: H2 semantic size. 28→42px fluid.

variables.name: h3
variables.description: H3 semantic size. 22→32px fluid.

variables.name: h4
variables.description: H4 semantic size. 18→24px fluid.

variables.name: h5
variables.description: H5 semantic size. 16→20px fluid.

variables.name: h6
variables.description: H6 semantic size. 14→16px fluid.

variables.name: text-line-height
variables.description: Body line height. ex unit scales automatically with any font size and typeface.

variables.name: heading-line-height
variables.description: Heading line height. Tighter than body for visual density.

variables.name: text-font-weight
variables.description: Font weight for body text.

variables.name: heading-font-weight
variables.description: Font weight for headings.

variables.name: space-xs
variables.description: 10→14px fluid. Tight inline gaps, icon padding.

variables.name: space-s
variables.description: 13→20px fluid. Component padding, list item gaps.

variables.name: space-m
variables.description: 16→28px fluid. Base. Default content gap, card padding.

variables.name: space-l
variables.description: 20→40px fluid. Section padding, generous content gaps.

variables.name: space-xl
variables.description: 25→56px fluid. Section vertical rhythm, hero padding.

variables.name: space-2xl
variables.description: 31→79px fluid. Large section breaks.

variables.name: space-3xl
variables.description: 39→112px fluid. Hero sections, full-page spacing.

variables.name: space-4xl
variables.description: 49→158px fluid. Maximum landing page vertical space.

variables.name: min-screen-width
variables.description: Fluid scale lower bound. Reference value only — CSS custom properties cannot be used in @media queries.

variables.name: max-screen-width
variables.description: Fluid scale upper bound. Type and spacing reach maximum values at this viewport width.

variables.name: container-width
variables.description: Default site container max-width.

variables.name: max-width
variables.description: Content column max-width for readable text layouts.

variables.name: max-width-m
variables.description: Medium content max-width. Blog posts, prose-heavy content.

variables.name: max-width-s
variables.description: Small content max-width. Forms, modals, narrow focused layouts.

variables.name: radius-none
variables.description: No border radius. Sharp corners. Completes the scale for BEM modifier overrides.

variables.name: radius-xs
variables.description: 3→4px fluid. Tags, badges, chips. Fluid for consistency with all other radius tokens.

variables.name: radius-s
variables.description: 6→8px fluid. Inputs, small buttons.

variables.name: radius-m
variables.description: 8→12px fluid. Default for cards and buttons.

variables.name: radius-l
variables.description: 12→16px fluid. Panels, modals, larger cards.

variables.name: radius-xl
variables.description: 16→20px fluid. Feature cards, hero image containers.

variables.name: radius-full
variables.description: Pill / full-circle radius. Avatars, toggles, pill buttons.

variables.name: shadow-color
variables.description: Shadow base colour. Light: inherits heading-color (dark shadow on light bg). Dark: pure black (deep shadow on dark bg). All shadow-* tokens reference this.

variables.name: shadow-xs
variables.description: Hairline lift. Inputs, chips.

variables.name: shadow-s
variables.description: Gentle lift. Buttons, small cards.

variables.name: shadow-m
variables.description: Default card elevation.

variables.name: shadow-l
variables.description: Hover states, dropdowns, floating panels.

variables.name: shadow-xl
variables.description: Modals, dialogs, deep floating layers.

variables.name: transition
variables.description: Default 200ms smooth transition. Use for reveals, toggles, and panel animations.

variables.name: transition-fast
variables.description: Fast 100ms transition. Use for hover microinteractions: colour shifts, opacity, underlines.

variables.name: z-dropdown
variables.description: Z-index for dropdowns and select menus.

variables.name: z-sticky
variables.description: Z-index for sticky headers and pinned navigation bars.

variables.name: z-overlay
variables.description: Z-index for backdrop overlays behind modals and drawers.

variables.name: z-modal
variables.description: Z-index for modal dialogs, drawers, and off-canvas panels.

variables.name: z-tooltip
variables.description: Z-index for tooltips. Highest layer — always visible above all other elements.

variables.name: focus-ring-color
variables.description: Focus ring colour. References --primary so it always matches the brand. WCAG 2.4.11 (Level AA, WCAG 2.2).

variables.name: focus-ring-width
variables.description: Focus ring stroke width. 2px (0.2rem at 62.5% root). WCAG 2.4.11 minimum.

variables.name: focus-ring-offset
variables.description: Focus ring offset from element edge. 2px (0.2rem at 62.5% root).
